episodeTitle.en: Building a magical AI code editor used by over 1m developers in 4 months: Inside Windsurf
episodeTitle.zh: 如何在4个月内打造吸引超过100万开发者的神奇AI代码编辑器：Windsurf内部故事

guestBioOfficial.en: Varun Mohan is the co-founder and CEO of Windsurf (formerly Codeium), an AI-powered development environment (IDE) that has been used by over 1 million developers in just four months and has quickly emerged as a leader in transforming how developers build software. Prior to finding success with Windsurf, the company pivoted twice—first from GPU virtualization infrastructure to an IDE plugin, and then to their own standalone IDE. In this conversation, you'll learn:
guestBioOfficial.zh: 瓦伦·莫汉（Varun Mohan）是Windsurf（前身为Codeium）的联合创始人兼首席执行官。这款由人工智能驱动的开发环境（IDE）在短短四个月内就吸引了超过100万名开发者，并迅速成为变革开发者软件构建方式的领军者。Windsurf取得成功之前，公司曾两次转型——先是从GPU虚拟化基础设施转向IDE插件，再转向自主研发的独立IDE。在本次对话中，您将了解：

title.en: Building a magical AI code editor used by over 1m developers in 4 months: Inside Windsurf
title.zh: 如何在4个月内打造吸引超过100万开发者的神奇AI代码编辑器：Windsurf内部故事

summary.en: Varun shares what makes Windsurf unique, why they invested heavily in enterprise sales unusually early, and why agency is becoming the most important skill for engineers and product builders. He tells the origin story of pivoting from a GPU infrastructure company to a much bigger opportunity in AI coding tools. The episode is a sharp look at building a category-defining developer product in the AI era.
summary.zh: Varun 分享了 Windsurf 的独特之处、为何他们在很早阶段就异乎寻常地重投企业销售，以及为什么“能动性（agency）”正成为工程师与产品构建者最重要的技能。他讲述了从一家 GPU 基础设施公司，转向 AI 编程工具这一更大机会的起源故事。本期是在 AI 时代打造定义品类之开发者产品的犀利透视。
